name: [💧UPDATE 1💧] Benders Battle Arena
desc:
Welcome to Benders Battle Arena - a fun and chaotic battle royale-style game where you have the ability to control the elements to your wishes and go to battle!

🧭 Explore the kingdom of Earth...
⚔️ Fight off the most dangerous elite benders and find your own unique style!!!
❓️ Conquer quests and uncover powerful new techniques...

Press N To open the menu !

🤔🤔How To Unlock your Sub Bending's Move 🤔🤔
Step 1: Get your sub bending scroll from your bendings boss.
Step 2: Talk to you bending's Master to evolve it.
Final Step 3: do it again then enjoy your Fully Evolved Sub Bending.

Level cap 125
Current bending styles available 
Flame, Air, Earth, Water

Current Sub bending styles available 
Lava, Blood , Lightning , Fear, Snow
